$comment: Catalog v3 (2026-07-30, consolidation per Bri) — 4 stores x 3 items, all 12 prices globally unique so any revealed amount identifies the item. class: V/W/B (villager/werebear/both) x off/def, or 'cover'. Effects resolve: venison > bearsbane/trap; ham > announcement; charm shatters on use, saves absolutely; barrel = no vote + uneatable. Economy: 50 XLM buy-in, +15 XLM/day.

items.label: Horseshoe nail
items.effect: Cover. Looks like you might have bought something worse.

items.label: Bear trap
items.effect: If you are eaten, the werebear is wounded: it cannot kill the next night.

items.label: Silver charm
items.effect: Survive one night attack, publicly — the charm shatters on use. The werebear cannot buy it.

items.label: A bottle
items.effect: Cover. The shopkeeper sells drink now. Times are hard.

items.label: The good barrel
items.effect: Dead drunk: you cannot vote today and cannot be eaten tonight.

items.label: Smoked ham
items.effect: A well-fed bear leaves quietly: a failed attack tonight is not announced.

items.label: Fresh venison
items.effect: The werebear's next attack pierces bearsbane and bear traps. In villager hands: pure chaos.

items.label: Votive candle
items.effect: Cover. A small light against a large problem.

items.label: Lantern oil
items.effect: Posthumous: if you are eaten, Maude reads one true fact about the werebear's purchases by your still-lit lantern.

items.label: Bearsbane tincture
items.effect: Silently survive one night attack. Consumed; nobody is told.
